payload.instruction: Move the book behind the flower
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: The book is moved behind the flower.
outcome.target: The book is visibly positioned behind the flower, with the flower in front of it.
outcome.reference: Compare the book’s and flower’s relative positions and occlusion in the edited image.

check.question: Compared with SOURCE, has the blue book visibly moved toward being behind either flower in EDITED?
check.complete_when: The book is visibly behind a flower, with the flower in front of it.
check.partial_when: The book has visibly moved closer to either flower relative to SOURCE, even if it is not yet behind or occluded by one.
check.absent_when: The book has not visibly moved closer to either flower relative to SOURCE; it remains separate with no discernible progress toward being behind one.
check.unknown_when: The book, flowers, or their relative positions in SOURCE and EDITED cannot be reliably identified or compared.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"In SOURCE, the blue book is well left of the flower. In EDITED, it has moved close to the left flower and is visibly partly occluded by the foreground open book; the flower is in front of the blue book."}
